message:
Melissa, you don't need an MA in Rhet/Comp in order to get into a Rhet/Comp PhD program -- but I would suggest that having some coursework that gives you an idea of the shape of the field will make you a much stronger candidate. At the very least, I'd recommend familiarizing yourself with the [Bedford Bibliography](http://www.bedfordstmartins.com/bb/contents.html).

I don't know anything about Utah's program, I'm afraid.
